name: Natsu no Owari ni
source:
At summer's end, we change our grades; the season changes into autumn; the leaves change color; but what of our friendships and our loves?

[From [url=http://www.insani.org/atsummersend.html]insani[/url]]
translation:
夏日终末，我们换了年级；季节转入秋季；树叶变了颜色；但我们的友情和爱情又将如何？

[引自[url=http://www.insani.org/atsummersend.html]insani[/url]]
